name: the 2026-10-04 trap: kill by port, quoted -- two pids become one bad argument
the obvious 'fix': kill by port, unquoted -- kills the stranger on that port
the server started without a process group of its own
a busy asked-for port cleared by killing its holder
from:
if port_answers "$PORT"; then
    echo "mock-selfcheck: port :$PORT is already taken by another process -- left alone; pick another MOCK_SELFCHECK_PORT"
    exit 1
  fi

name: the trap signals the group but does not wait for it to be gone
from:
while kill -0 -- "-$g" 2>/dev/null; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    if [ "$i" -ge 50 ]; then
      kill -KILL -- "-$g" 2>/dev/null
      break
    fi
    sleep 0.1
  done
